implementation: The shared ordered-field Bernstein isolator now continues its existing refinement loop until a nonpoint interval excludes every separately emitted exact root from both boundaries. Hypercurve retained the original polynomial and returned Decided(Equal) when comparing the nonzero root to zero. Its refiner could likewise select the removed endpoint.

Boundary separation can discover another exact root (1/1024); ordinary deflation then returns both distinct exact witnesses.
